description:
Philadelphia, United States of America (USA).



Title reads 'The Army - Navy Game'.



Various shots of activities on field prior to the game as members of Army & Navy parade on fields. MS. American President John F. Kennedy sitting with Army for first half. Various shots of game, Navy in the lead. LS. President Kennedy swops sides of stadium to join the Navy for second half. MS. Kennedy sitting with Navy. Various shots of the match in progress, navy wins 13-7. 



(Comb F.G.)



Date found in the old record - 04/12/1961.
